study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modeling of brain MRI data identifies small subcortical volumes and associations with cognitive function in youth with fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD)

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: CIFASD Phase 4 participant data from the University of Minnesota; CentileBrain normative model training data primarily from the ENIGMA consortium.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Participants were children and adolescents, ages 8 -17, who were part of a Collaborative Initiative on FASD (CIFASD) study... Data from this study are part of CIFASD Phase 4 (2017 -2022)."; "the training data used in creating the CentileBrain model were primarily collected from the Enhancing Neuroimaging Genetics through MetaAnalysis (ENIGMA) Consortium"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Gimbel2025.pdf.md: 2.1. Participants; Gimbel2025.pdf.md: 2.4. MRI acquisition and processing

answer.CIFASD: FASD and typically-developing comparison participants for MRI and analyses

answer.ENIGMA: Normative training data for the CentileBrain model used to generate z-scores

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: CIFASD participants (ages 8-17) formed the study sample; CentileBrain uses an aggregated normative dataset (37,407 comparison brains) trained primarily on ENIGMA data to derive norm-adjusted z-scores.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Participants were children and adolescents, ages 8 -17, who were part of a Collaborative Initiative on FASD (CIFASD) study"; "the training data used in creating the CentileBrain model were primarily collected from the Enhancing Neuroimaging Genetics through MetaAnalysis (ENIGMA) Consortium"; "Individual regional volumetric z-scores were generated using CentileBrain... an aggregated neuroimaging dataset with a large number of individuals (37,407 comparison brains)."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Gimbel2025.pdf.md: 2.1. Participants; Gimbel2025.pdf.md: 2.4. MRI acquisition and processing; Gimbel2025.pdf.md: 2.5. Derivation of norm-adjusted volumetric scores

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: CentileBrain aggregated normative dataset includes 37,407 comparison brains; no train/validation split reported.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Individual regional volumetric z-scores were generated using CentileBrain (Ge et al., 2024), an open source online software tool that leverages an aggregated neuroimaging dataset with a large number of individuals (37,407 comparison brains)."
